data.text: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in his commandments.
data.titulo: The Blessing of Those Who Fear the LORD

data.text: His offspring will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.
Light dawns in the darkness for the upright; he is gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
It goes well with the man who is gracious and lends, who conducts his affairs with justice.
For he will never be shaken; the righteous will be remembered forever.
data.titulo: A Steadfast Heart and Open Hands

data.text: He will not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
His heart is secure; he will not fear, until he looks upon his adversaries.
He has freely distributed his gifts to the needy; his righteousness endures forever. His horn will be lifted high in honor.
The wicked man will see and be angry; he will gnash his teeth and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
